text:
incident-bot: PAGER: gateway-5xx surge detected for service=redwood-gateway us-east-1 — impact: increased 5xx (502/504) and request timeouts. Pager: sanjay (oncall)

sanjay (oncall): seeing ~12% 5xx at the edge, TTLs spiking to 2-3s. Circuit-breaker kicking on a few backend pools. Does anyone see recent deploys to gateway?

maria (eng-sre): no deploys in last 30m from eng-releases. Telemetry shows backend pool "model-proxy-a" latency rising, queue depth up. Starting tcpdump to confirm connection resets.

li (platform): routing config shows recent experimental fallback policy enabled at 03:10 — weight 10% to fallback variant. I'm toggling it back to 0% now.

ops-automation: action: temporarily disable fallback routing for model-proxy-a -> command: `redwood route update --service model-proxy-a --fallback 0`

sanjay (oncall): done, confirming. 5xx rate dropped to 7% but still elevated. Paging infra team to check NLB health.

jack (support): we have two customers reporting timeouts on embeddings endpoint. CS ticket #5541 opened. Notified account execs.

eva (product): ETA communicated? need to know if data plane retries caused duplicate charges.

maria (eng-sre): running quick mitigation: reduce per-request fanout at gateway to 1, disable aggressive parallelism, enable short-circuit on timeout 800ms -> patch rolling out to edge pool now: 
```
# patch snippet
- gateway.conf: parallel_fanout: 1
- timeouts: request_timeout_ms: 800
- circuit: max_concurrent: 250
```

ops-automation: deploy started to pool edge-1, edge-2.

sanjay (oncall): monitoring... 5xx at 2.1% now, customer errors still visible but decreasing. Keeping pager open for 30m.

maria (eng-sre): confirmed root cause pattern: upstream model-proxy-a started rejecting streams with 502 when KV-cache auth requests from a new agent spike overlapped with long-running requests. Reproducer included.

li (platform): found infra-level flapping on one host in model-proxy-a ASG (oom-kill events). Marking instance i-0a3f as unhealthy and replacing.

jack (support): updated customers: partial impact, retries may have succeeded, recommending they retry idempotently.

eva (product): summarize customer impact for execs pls — we need counts and affected regions.

maria (eng-sre): quick numbers: peak affected requests ~18k/min, ~1.8% of global traffic for 12m, primarily us-east-1. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings.

sanjay (oncall): closing active pager at 2159999999+420s once metrics stable, moving to follow-up thread.

-- FOLLOWUP ACTIONS --

maria (eng-sre): ACTION: cherry-pick hotfix to gateway to keep parallel_fanout conservative and add backpressure metric (PR: rwd/gateway#2048). Owner: maria. Due: +24h.

li (platform): ACTION: add automatic host replacement on oom-kill in ASG for model-proxy-a, plus an early-warning alert for process OOM count > 1 in 5m. Owner: li. Due: +48h.

ops-automation: ACTION: add temporary secondary-circuit fallback run that prefers cached responses when upstream latency > 700ms. Owner: ops-automation. Due: +6h (hotpatch window).

jack (support): ACTION: create templated customer communication summarizing impact, retries, and mitigation steps. Owner: jack. Due: +3h.

eva (product): ACTION: request billing check for any double-billed tokens during retry window and notify finance if > $500. Owner: eva. Due: +72h.

sanjay (oncall): RUNBOOK UPDATE: editing gateway runbook - new step after paging: 1) check fallback routing flags, 2) reduce parallel_fanout, 3) mark unhealthy hosts and replace, 4) escalate if 5xx > 5% for 10m. I'll submit PR to docs/rundown.

maria (eng-sre): ALERT TUNING: current alarm `gateway_5xx_pct` triggers at 1% across region; that's too sensitive for noisy tails. Proposal: region-level alert at 3% over 5m with per-pool tagging. I'll open the alert change request.

li (platform): LOGS: saved tcpdump + pcap to s3://incidents/2159999999/pcap.zip and uploaded heapdump from i-0a3f to s3://incidents/2159999999/heapdump.tar.gz.

ops-automation: POSTMORTEM NOTES: immediate mitigations: disabled experimental fallback, reduced fanout, replaced oom-killed host. Next: hotfix + runbook + alert tuning.

sanjay (oncall): ok team — we have owners and deadlines. I'll follow for the next 48h and schedule a 30min debrief tomorrow 09:00 UTC. react with :thumbsup: when you've accepted your action.

maria (eng-sre): :thumbsup: accepted.

li (platform): :thumbsup: accepted.

jack (support): :thumbsup: accepted.

eva (product): :thumbsup: accepted.

ops-automation: Automated note: runbook change request created: docs change id 6782.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: gateway-5xx (2159999999) — mitigations successful, monitoring.
